title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — scarce other locus ties corruption from Adam to all
pass_a_gloss: Other sacred places may show we are born corrupt with sin; almost none teaches that this corruption, streaming from Adam himself, overran every human. That scarcity matters here.
pass_b_english: And although there are other places in the sacred letters from which it can be made out that we are born corrupt with sin, yet there is almost no other which teaches that that corruption, proceeding from Adam himself, invaded into all humans. That scarcity matters here.
source_text: & quamvis alia extent in sacris literis loca, ex quibus effici possit, nos nasci corruptos peccato, tamen fere alius nullus est, qui eam corruptionem doceat ab ipso Adamo profectam in omnes homines invasisse.

choices.choice: Almost no other text ties birth-corruption as from Adam to all
